About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Are you interested in gaining hands-on experience within Global Procurement at one of the world's leading jewellery brands? Do you enjoy working with data, analysis, and stakeholder collaboration in a dynamic international environment?

Pandora is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Procurement team. In this role, you will support sourcing activities, procurement projects, and business analysis across different spend categories while working closely with category managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into procurement within a global organisation operating across the full value chain. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will contribute to sourcing activities, supplier management, data analysis, and process improvements while building both professional skills and practical business experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will be exposed to a variety of tasks within Procurement and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation. We expect you to take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute proactively to ongoing projects and initiatives.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Support Procurement colleagues with various procurement activities

• Contribute to sourcing projects and tenders across spend categories

• Project manage smaller projects and tasks independently

• Conduct data analyses and create business insights

• Create and deliver presentations for internal stakeholders

• Assist with the implementation of new processes across the global organisation

• Engage in dialogue with suppliers on various topics, including compliance-related activities

• Support data quality initiatives and ad hoc administrative tasks related to contract management

Your Team

Working in Global Procurement, you will join a team that partners with stakeholders across Pandora to drive value through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives across a broad range of indirect spend categories.

The Global Procurement team is part of the Group Commercial organisation. You will work alongside more than 20 skilled colleagues in an international and collaborative environment and report to the Director of one of our Indirect Procurement categories.

You will be part of an exciting business area and work in an international hub of passionate, performance-driven, and can-do spirited colleagues.

Qualifications

You might be the person we are looking for if you are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and ideally have at least two years remaining before graduation.

We hope you can demonstrate:

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or similar in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Economics, or Data Management

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Strong Excel skills and an analytical mindset

• A genuine interest in Procurement and related disciplines

• Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions

• A flair for creating professional and impactful presentations in PowerPoint

Personal Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

• A humble and enthusiastic team player

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• Structured and detail-oriented in their approach

• Not afraid to take initiative and responsibility

• Ambitious and motivated to develop professionally

You Will Get

A position as Student Assistant in Global Procurement offers an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organisation.

You will get:

• Valuable work experience from a globally recognised brand within Procurement across different spend categories

• Exposure to a fast-moving and dynamic environment where our people and values are at the centre of what we do

• A chance to challenge yourself and apply what you have learned in a global business environment

• Support and coaching from your manager as well as a diverse and experienced team

• Flexible working hours, especially around exam periods

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible and required).

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

New Power Partners is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and building projects across Europe.

The role is responsible for managing projects from planning and procurement through construction and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.

In addition to project delivery, the role includes supporting business growth through client development, tender support, and identifying new opportunities. As the business expands, the successful candidate will play a key role in mentoring colleagues and, over time, helping establish and develop a team of project managers and specialists.

About Site Solutions

Site Solutions develops and delivers turnkey solutions for the onshore and offshore wind industry – covering everything from facilities and workforce logistics to operational planning and site coordination. We work closely with global project teams to ensure efficient site setups that keep projects running smoothly and safely.

Site Solutions is a great team of nine employees, and the Senior Project Manager will work closely with all team members while contributing both strategically and operationally to the development and delivery of our services.

While our heritage is rooted in the wind industry, we increasingly support customers across construction, infrastructure and industrial sectors where temporary site facilities are critical for successful project execution.

What the role offers

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

• Lead construction and building projects from initiation to completion.

• Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, and project risks.

• Coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.

• Ensure projects comply with applicable regulations, HSE requirements, and quality standards.

• Provide clear project governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

Commercial & Client Management

• Build and maintain strong client relationships.

• Support tendering, procurement, and contract management activities.

• Manage project commercial performance, including budgets, forecasts, variations, and claims.

• Identify opportunities for additional services and long-term client collaboration.

Business Development

• Support business growth through networking, client engagement, and market development.

• Contribute to proposals, commercial discussions, and new project opportunities.

• Help strengthen New Power Partners' position within the Danish construction sector.

Team Development

• Mentor and support junior project managers and consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across projects.

• Support recruitment and onboarding as the team grows.

• Contribute to building a collaborative and high-performing project organization.

Qualifications & Experience

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Technology, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of project management experience within the Danish building and construction industry.

• Proven track record delivering commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

• Strong understanding of Danish construction processes and regulations.

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and stakeholder management.

• Familiarity with AB18, ABT18, and ABR18 is an advantage.

• Fluent in Danish and English.

Key Competencies

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

• Commercially minded with sound contractual understanding.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented.

• Ability to balance hands-on project execution with business development.

• Leadership potential with an interest in developing people and teams.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

• Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

• Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

• Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

• Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

• Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

**About You

**You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

• Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

• Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

• Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

• Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

• Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

**What We Offer You

**This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply by submitting your CV, cover letter and grade transcripts. If you have any questions before applying you can reach out to hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fdi@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Your mission

As our Carbon Removal Supply Lead, a new role here at Klimate, you will build and own the systems, data, and market intelligence of our carbon supply sourcing. You will strengthen sourcing as a function and enable strategic and commercial decision-making grounded in strong supplier relationships, accurate market information, and well-governed internal data.

You will sit within the Sourcing team and report directly to Matt Averna, Head of Markets & Policy.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Storebrand, Dalberg, OC&C, and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What you'll do

In the first 3–6 months, you will:

• Become fluent in Klimate’s sourcing priorities, supplier base, and contracting approach for carbon removal projects.

• Independently prepare for and contribute to supplier meetings, using structured data and clear market context.

• Support and share responsibility of supplier meetings, preparing materials and ensuring learnings are captured in internal systems.

• Manage projects and contracts in Klimate’s administrative inventory system, coordinating with internal stakeholders where needed.

• Take ownership of existing supplier and project data across sourcing systems, ensuring it is well structured, consistent, and up-to-date.

As you grow into the role, you will:

• Own the ongoing development and governance of Klimate’s sourcing database, ensuring it reliably supports day-to-day sourcing and strategic decision-making.

• Generate regular, data-driven market and commercial insights (e.g. pricing, geographies, project categories, contracting terms) to inform sourcing focus and prioritisation.

• Actively manage supplier relationships in collaboration with sourcing leadership, ensuring accurate management in our data systems.

• Execute contracting of carbon removal purchase agreements with structured inputs from market data and supplier interactions.

• Serve as a sparring partner to sourcing leadership and relevant internal teams on sourcing focus, market coverage, and portfolio construction.

**Requirements & Skills

**

Must-have

• Relevant work experience in carbon markets, climate tech, energy markets, or a closely related sourcing or market analysis field.

• Pre-existing experience working with carbon market supply, ideally in an intermediary or transaction-oriented role with broad market exposure.

• Strong understanding of commercial terms and contracting logic, and comfort engaging with complex contract language and deal structures.

• High data literacy, with experience designing, maintaining, and working with structured databases or admin systems (tool-agnostic).

• Comfort working at the intersection of supplier engagement, market analysis, and data operations, combining people-centric soft skills with quantitative ability.

• Ability to take ownership of complex, evolving problem spaces, translating high-level objectives into pragmatic execution.

Nice-to-have

• Direct experience with carbon removal projects or technologies.

• Experience producing external-facing market reports, briefs, or thought leadership content.

• Familiarity with policy or subsidy mechanisms relevant to carbon markets.

• Experience collaborating with product, sales, or digital teams on data or systems integration.

Who you are

• You are highly analytical and value data as the basis for decision-making.

• You are comfortable working independently within a coaching-oriented management style, translating broad direction into concrete actions.

• You proactively identify opportunities for improvement and propose ideas, analyses, or new ways of structuring work.

• You are curious, and motivated by bringing clarity and order to complex or fragmented information.

• You are comfortable representing Klimate externally in supplier conversations while grounding discussions in facts, data, and commercial logic.

What we offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Team sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP, ideally no later than April 2027.

Location: We expect this role to be Copenhagen based, but encourage anyone with permission to work in the EU to apply.

What to include in your application

• Your CV. Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

• A short cover letter. Focus on your experience with carbon markets and working with data-driven decision making - those are the key elements of succeeding in the role.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with Britt, our People & Culture Partner

• 30 min interview with Matt, our head of Markets & Policy

• Small case & cultural interview with Matt and another member of the Klimate team

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX.

**Location: Kalundborg, Denmark

****Department: API Expansions - Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution

Do you enjoy collaborating across technical disciplines, turning challenges into opportunities and helping shape the future of production facilities?

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our IT, Automation & Robotics team within API Expansions at Novo.

If you have project management experience, a good understanding of industrial IT and automation, and the ambition to develop your career within a growing project organisation, we would love to hear from you.

**The position

**As our new Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading IT, Automation and Robotics workstreams within largescale capital investment projects across API Expansions.

You will primarily work in the early phases of projects, helping define scope, establish requirements, develop reliable plans and forecasts, and ensure that technical uncertainties are identified and addressed before projects progress into execution.

Working closely with Solution Architects, engineering partners and colleagues across the organisation, you will help translate operational and technical requirements into structured project deliverables.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading and coordinating IT, Automation and Robotics project activities within major capital investment programmes.

• Developing project scope, schedules, cost estimates, forecasts and delivery plans in accordance with Novo's global standards.

• Collaborating with Solution Architects and technical specialists to understand proposed solutions, dependencies and potential project risks.

• Working closely with Process, Engineering, Global IT, Quality and other stakeholders to align requirements and project objectives.

• Coordinating external engineering partners, suppliers and system integrators to support successful project delivery.

• Identifying technical uncertainties and opportunities early, helping establish robust solutions before projects move into detailed design and execution.

The position offers exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, including purification, fermentation, recovery, logistics and utility facilities, providing opportunities to develop your experience across different manufacturing processes and technologies.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine that you bring a combination of project management experience, technical understanding and strong interpersonal skills.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• A relevant educational background in Engineering, Automation, IT, Project Management or a related technical discipline.

• At least three years of project management experience, preferably within industrial IT, automation, manufacturing or a related technical environment.

• A practical understanding of industrial IT/OT systems and automation technologies, with the ability to engage effectively with technical specialists.

• Experience in project planning, scheduling, cost estimation, forecasting, risk management or coordinating project deliverables.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and influencing stakeholders without direct line management responsibility.

• Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

Above all, you bring a collaborative mindset, a willingness to develop and the ambition to make a meaningful contribution to both project outcomes and the continued development of the team.

**About The Department

**You will join the Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution department within API Expansions, supporting the IT, Automation and Robotics elements of major capital investment projects.

Our department brings together Project Managers, Project Directors and Solution Architects who collaborate across disciplines to support the development of new facilities and the modernisation of existing manufacturing operations.

A central part of our approach is to identify and resolve technical uncertainties early in the project lifecycle, enabling stronger project definition, more reliable forecasts and smoother execution.

We work closely with colleagues across Novo, as well as external engineering partners and technology suppliers, supporting projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will join a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and professional development are encouraged.

You will receive support from your manager and experienced colleagues as you develop your knowledge of our project standards, technologies and ways of working, with the opportunity to take increasing ownership of complex projects.

The position is based in Kalundborg, with an expectation of approximately four days per week on site. The remaining day may be worked flexibly, including from another Novo location, subject to business needs.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we are driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases.

For more than a century, we have worked to improve the lives of people living with serious chronic conditions. Our success is built on scientific innovation, a commitment to quality and the dedication of our colleagues around the world.

Joining Novo means becoming part of an organisation where your work contributes to something bigger.

Within API Expansions, you will have the opportunity to help develop and modernise manufacturing facilities that support the delivery of life changing medicines to patients around the world.

**Working at Novo

**Every day, we seek solutions that make a lasting difference for patients.

We recognise that meaningful progress requires collaboration, curiosity and the willingness to challenge conventional thinking.

Our people bring different perspectives, experiences and expertise, united by a shared commitment to improving patients' lives.

We provide an environment where you can take ownership, develop professionally and contribute to projects that have a meaningful impact.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is 651,000 to 956,900 DKK per annum, depending on experience, qualifications and applicable local arrangements.

Novo offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support the wellbeing, development and long term success of our employees.

**Incentives And Benefits

**In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for benefits and incentive arrangements in accordance with applicable Novo policies and local employment terms.

Further information about the relevant compensation and benefits package will be provided during the recruitment process.

**What We Offer

**At Novo, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work while developing your professional capabilities.In this position, you can look forward to:

• Working on significant capital investment projects supporting the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing.

• Exposure to advanced IT, automation and robotics technologies.

• Opportunities to gain experience across different manufacturing processes and project environments.

• Collaboration with experienced technical specialists, engineering partners and international colleagues.

• Professional development, mentoring and the opportunity to take increasing ownership of complex projects.

• A supportive, collaborative team that values initiative, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

We encourage interested colleagues to apply as early as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity.

At Novo, we recognise that diversity of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences strengthens our ability to innovate and deliver meaningful outcomes.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and providing equal opportunities for all qualified applicants.

We encourage applications from colleagues with different experiences and career paths who believe they can contribute to the success of the team.

**Together, we drive change

**At Novo, we are united by our commitment to defeating serious chronic diseases.

Our people, our expertise and our willingness to embrace new ideas enable us to make a difference for patients around the world.

If you are motivated by the opportunity to develop your project management career while contributing to the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing, we look forward to receiving your application.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Construction Manager for Great Belt Projects at Sund & Bælt
jobs.description:
Would you like to be close to the on-site work as we renew the Great Belt Fixed Link?

As Construction Manager for bridge works, you will play a key role in the renewal of one of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets, working close to both the technical solutions and day-to-day construction activities.

In Great Belt Projects, you will contribute to projects including the West Bridge Bearing Refurbishment, where bearings on the West Bridge between Nyborg and Sprogø are being refurbished and replaced. The work is carried out while the Great Belt Fixed Link remains operational, requiring a strong focus on safety, quality and precise coordination.

The position

As Construction Manager, you will act as Sund & Bælt’s day-to-day coordinating client representative on site. You will monitor the contractor’s work and contribute to ensuring safe and controlled execution in accordance with the contract, approved methods and project requirements.

You will be part of the Great Belt Projects team and collaborate closely with project management, Contract Administration, Project Controls, Design & Engineering, HSE specialists, consultants, the contractor and Great Belt Operations.

Your primary base will be in Halsskov, with the option of working selected days from our office at Vester Søgade in Copenhagen. The role also requires your presence at relevant worksites and project locations.

Responsibilities

As Construction Manager, you will ensure effective coordination, documentation and timely follow-up on site activities. You will represent the client’s interests with a strong focus on safety, quality and progress. You will be responsible for site supervision and carry out supervision activities yourself when required.  Your key responsibilities will include:

• Managing day-to-day client-side construction assurance through the consultants’ site supervision services, including monitoring the contractor’s execution of the works, resourcing, plant and equipment, site access, logistics and progress.

• Monitoring the contractor’s compliance with occupational health and safety, emergency preparedness, environmental and climate requirements, promoting an open and proactive safety culture, and coordinating fulfilment of the client’s occupational health and safety obligations.

• Reviewing and following up on the contractor’s method statements, risk assessments, quality documentation and inspection and test plans in collaboration with the project consultants, coordinating technical supervision and ensuring timely follow-up on site observations.

• Coordinating interfaces between bridge works, operations, site access, land-based logistics, other contracts and relevant marine activities, and facilitating the associated construction, safety, logistics and planning meetings.

• Maintaining accurate, factual site records and providing timely input on progress, variations, quantities, delays, risks, cost performance and potential contractual matters, escalating significant issues to project management. In cooperation with the Project Manager, monitoring day-to-day expenditure and cost variances for the bridge works, planning and chairing construction meetings, recording decisions, responsibilities and deadlines, and following up on agreed actions.

Your background

You have a relevant technical background, for example as a civil engineer, structural engineer, construction technologist, architectural technologist or similar. Most importantly, you have documented experience in construction management, site management, technical supervision or supervision coordination from complex civil engineering, refurbishment or maintenance projects. We also expect that you:

Have experience with bridges, structures, operational infrastructure, areas open to traffic or other technically and safety-critical worksites.

• Have a solid understanding of contractor planning, method statements, risk assessments, quality and inspection plans, as well as documentation requirements.

• Have experience with occupational health and safety, emergency preparedness and the safe coordination of multiple parties.

• Are able to document site conditions accurately and systematically, providing a sound basis for progress monitoring, contract administration, risk management and decision-making.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English. Knowledge of AB18, Danish occupational health and safety regulations, construction contracts, technical standards and document management systems is an advantage.

You as a person

You are practical, clear in your communication and highly collaborative, with the ability to create structure, maintain focus and drive progress. You thrive in a complex environment with multiple simultaneous activities and stakeholders and have the judgement and confidence to act and escalate issues when necessary.

You take a solution-oriented approach and are skilled at fostering constructive dialogue, while maintaining a clear client role and respecting the contractor’s responsibility for its own planning, execution, safety, quality and documentation.

What do we offer?

At Sund & Bælt, you will become part of an international workplace where skilled colleagues work together towards shared goals. There is room for flexibility, new ideas and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. You will have responsibility and the opportunity to make a difference through work that matters to society. We also offer:

• Health and dental insurance

• A salary package based on qualifications

• A pension scheme

• A staff canteen scheme

Interested?

We aim to be an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity.

We therefore encourage everyone to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or disability.

You can submit your CV until the application deadline of 8 December 2026 by following the link below.

As Sund & Bælt manages critical infrastructure, please note that security clearance is a condition of your employment. Further information will be provided later in the recruitment process.

If you have any further questions, please contact Pedro da Silva Jørgensen at psj@sbf.dk.

You can find more information about Sund & Bælt on our website at www.sundogbaelt.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £75,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

• Work closely with experienced colleagues across EY’s Nordic and global network

As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a talented student assistant to strengthen our embedded systems work.

As Student Assistant in Embedded Systems, you will develop the firmware that brings our photonics lab setups to life. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity, and expectation, to see your code run on real lab equipment from day one.

Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers, ensuring robust, well-structured code that supports our lab setups and experiments.

Interfaces & Device Control: Connect, configure, and control external devices over SPI and I2C, while ensuring reliable communication between the microcontroller and the surrounding hardware.

Signal Generation, Acquisition & Processing: Generate signals and waveforms, acquire and monitor analog signals, and process the acquired data on the MCU through filtering, averaging, and feature extraction.

Interfaces & Peripherals: You have hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, DMA, timers, ADC, and DAC, from configuring the peripheral to debugging it on the bench.

Electronics: You are able to read and understand electronic circuits, schematics, and datasheets. Electronics skills such as circuit design, soldering, and measurement, as well as real-world lab experience, are considered an advantage. Experience with PCB design (KiCad or Altium) and Python or MATLAB for data analysis is a plus.

Soft Skills: You are a structured and independent problem-solver who enjoys working at the boundary between hardware and software, communicates effectively with colleagues, and thrives in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required.

The Perks

We care about your growth and development. You will work on cutting-edge photonics and embedded technology alongside highly motivated colleagues, with access to a well-equipped lab. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams, a positive culture with free snacks, and the opportunity to write your Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis with us.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

Do you want to help shape the strategic direction of Dalux’s international bid activities? And are you motivated by bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives to develop strong bid strategies? Then you might be our new Bid Manager!

**

• Developing and shaping bid strategies in close collaboration with senior management and relevant commercial teams.

• Conducting strategic bid/no-bid assessments to ensure that Dalux prioritises the opportunities with the strongest strategic fit and greatest potential for success.

• Analysing tender documentation, identifying risks and opportunities, and challenging the basis for our participation.

• Ensuring legal quality and effective risk management in collaboration with our Legal team.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams throughout complex bid processes and ensuring progress, structure, and quality.

• Gathering and applying market and competitor insights to strengthen Dalux’s position.

• Continuously optimising processes and ways of working to make the bid function more efficient and create space for strategic work.

**This sounds like a great fit for me!

**We imagine that you have solid experience with tender and bid processes, for example as a Bid Manager, Senior Bid Specialist or so. You have a strong understanding of public and private bids and tender regulations, including relevant EU rules, and can translate legal requirements into commercial decisions.

You are interested in working internationally and motivated by learning about new markets, cultures, and local interpretations of regulations and tender processes. International experience is an advantage, but your curiosity and desire to work across borders are just as important. You communicate confidently in English.

The role is first and foremost about setting the direction, driving the process, and ensuring quality across our bids. You will not necessarily be responsible for producing large volumes of bid material yourself. Instead, you will be able to quality-assure, challenge, and bring together input from relevant commercial and technical colleagues to create a strong and cohesive proposal.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and strategic in your approach. You have a natural project management overview and the ability to create structure and drive progress in complex processes involving many stakeholders.

You are confident in your professional expertise and have the maturity and composure needed to engage with different types of people from specialists and colleagues across our international organisation to managers and senior leadership. You are able to challenge and provide direction while remaining humble in your approach and bringing different perspectives together around a shared decision.

**Be part of Dalux’s success!

**At Dalux, we are committed to creating a workplace that inspires and motivates. We believe that wellbeing and job satisfaction go hand in hand with a healthy work environment which is why we believe excessive overtime should be a thing of the past.

We have an informal yet professional culture where everyone is welcome, without strict dress codes or unnecessary titles. You will become part of an engaged community where we do not just come together for work, but also for social activities such as shared dinners, workshops, wine tastings, knitting clubs, and running clubs or whatever we come up with next.

At our headquarters in Copenhagen, you will join a dedicated team in Business Operations, and you will collaborate and spar with colleagues across our offices in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and the rest of Europe. Wherever you are, you can expect a strong sense of community and a shared focus on innovation and success for both our customers and Dalux.

Applications are invited for a full-time, 3-year PhD position in CRISPR-based genome editing, with a preferred starting date of 1st of January 2027.

The Research Group

The project will be conducted in the research group led by Chief Physician Maria Rossing at MDxCore, Rigshospitalet, and is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Our group consists of six dedicated researchers working within genomic medicine and translational research. We offer a collaborative research environment and excellent facilities in modern laboratories at Rigshospitalet.

Project Details

CRISPR-based genome editing offers the potential to correct disease-causing genetic variants at their source. Recent clinical successes demonstrate that precise, patient-specific genome editing is feasible, but such approaches remain exceptional and have not yet been translated into systematic therapeutic pipelines for rare disorders. This project aims to develop a patient-tailored CRISPR-based therapy for Glanzmann thrombasthenia, a severe inherited bleeding disorder caused by defects in platelet integrin αIIbβ3. Focusing on pathogenic patient variants in the ITGA2B gene, we will establish a translational workflow spanning characterization of the genetic defect, development of relevant cellular models, optimization of genome-editing strategies, and assessment of functional rescue and editing safety. The most promising strategy will be evaluated in hematopoietic stem cells and preclinical models to assess efficacy, durability, and safety. The project will thereby establish a framework for translating individualized genome editing into potential therapies for rare genetic disorders.

Application deadline: 30st of November 2026, 23:59 CET

Preferred start date: 1st of January 2027

Duration: 3 years

Requirements

We are seeking a highly motivated and ambitious scientist with the following qualifications:

• A master’s in medicine, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field, completed before the application deadline

• Experience in CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing and molecular and cell biology

• Experience with cell culture and relevant molecular and biochemical techniques

• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary research team

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• A strong interest in translational research and the development of novel genome-editing therapies

Place of Employment

The position is based in the Rossing Research Group at MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry, Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark. Rigshospitalet is one of Denmark's leading university hospitals and is located centrally in Copenhagen.

Terms of Employment

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for three years. The average working week is 37 hours. Salary, pension, and other terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for employees in the Danish Regions.

Application

The application must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” no later than 31st of November 2026 at 23:59 (Copenhagen local time).

The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

• Letter of motivation describing previous research experience, research interests, and career plans (maximum 1 page)

• CV including education, research/work experience, language skills, and other relevant skills

• Copy of Master's degree certificate

• Transcripts of relevant previous degrees

• List of publications

• Letter(s) of recommendation (optional)

Applications received by email or through other platforms cannot be accepted.

Recruitment Process

Eligible applicants will be assessed based on their CV, motivation letter, qualifications, and submitted documentation. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an on-site or online interview. All applicants will be notified once the recruitment process has been completed.
